prompt:
Use the attached reference image as the exact character design reference.
Generate a full-body 2D side-scrolling sprite sheet for Unity using this character. Keep the character in the same style as the reference image. The character must remain visually consistent across all frames.
Create a clean orthographic side-view sprite sheet rendered in crisp retro pixel art, with sharp single-pixel outlines, a limited cohesive color palette, and no anti-aliasing, suited to a 2D quarter-view (3/4 top-down) game. The character should face RIGHT in every frame only. Full body must be visible in every frame. Keep the camera fixed, keep the character at a consistent scale, keep the ground level consistent, and keep the body centered within each frame. No perspective change, no motion blur, no extra props, no extra characters, no cropped limbs, and no background details.
Output one complete sprite sheet with a uniform grid. Every cell must be exactly 256x256 pixels, including the empty padding around the character, so that every frame occupies the same amount of space and the sheet can be sliced into equal cells. Place the character at the same position inside every cell: centered horizontally, with the feet on the same baseline. Use a plain solid white background with no shadow so the background can be removed later. Do not add any text, UI, captions, labels, or decorative borders.
Arrange the sprite sheet in separate animation rows:
Row 1: WALK cycle, 10 frames. Smooth looping side-walk animation with a light, rhythmic pixel-art bounce and clear leg readability, matching a quarter-view exploration pace.
Row 2: RUN cycle, 10 frames. Faster and more energetic than walking, smooth looping animation with a stronger forward lean, longer strides, and snappy pixel-perfect motion.
Row 3: BASIC ATTACK, 10 frames. One full attack motion with clear anticipation, action, impact, and recovery, returning to the starting pose; keep the swing punchy and readable frame-by-frame in classic pixel-art game style.
Row 4: DEATH animation, 10 frames. Clear hit reaction followed by collapse, ending in a defeated pose on the ground, staged with dramatic but clean pixel-art timing.
Important requirements:
- Keep the character proportions, outfit, and color palette identical in every frame.
- Make walk and run loop cleanly from the last frame back to the first frame.
- Keep silhouettes clear and readable for gameplay.
- Keep each frame fully inside its own cell, never touching or crossing cell boundaries.
- All cells must be identical in size, including padding, so the sheet can be sliced evenly on a uniform grid.
If supported, also export each individual frame separately using names like: walk_01 to walk_10, run_01 to run_10, attack_01 to attack_10, and death_01 to death_10. If separate frame export is not supported, generate only the complete sprite sheet.
